references.role: Existing game materials/render style, not layout

assets.name: room
assets.prompt:
Use case: sketch-to-render. Asset type: a real separate 2D game environment PNG layer for The Lootkeeper, not a mockup or sheet. Input image 1 is the user's composition sketch and is the authoritative layout reference. Input image 2 is the existing game's material/render style reference only. Render polished painterly fantasy game art, lightly stylized detailed 3D forms, softly painted textures, readable silhouettes, cool daylight from upper left, aged materials, no photoreal photography, no text, no UI, no watermark, no characters. The sketch defines a straight-on wide room with two matching arched windows, a broad warm wooden workbench with drawers, a dark squat mechanism on its left and a separate purple crystal orb just to its right. Preserve that composition across the separate layers. Do not add unrelated furniture or props.
OUTPUT ONLY THE EMPTY ROOM BACKGROUND LAYER. Wide 16:9 image, ideally 1536x864. Straight horizontal alignment, vertical walls, no tilted horizon. Pale weathered cool gray stone tower wall, two large symmetrically shaped rounded arched windows of equal width and height aligned on the same sill baseline. Window centers x=31% and x=69%, both from y=10% to y=57% of the canvas. Thick stone reveals, softly lit pale blue sky and a very subtle distant countryside outside. Broad quiet stone wall central pillar. Wall extends to the bottom behind where the table will be added as another layer. Empty darker lower stone courses. Match the simple architecture in the sketch, with restrained age and dust. Keep the center/edges quiet and light enough to read. EXCLUDE the entire table, drawers, mechanism, orb and foreground objects; they are separate assets. This PNG is opaque, wall and windows only. No black bars or margins.
